provenance.policy: Every hashed role binds exactly one included regular file with matching path/SHA/bytes and no symlink ancestry. Preparation without inventory stays unhashed/pending. Final publication requires all six roles; byte linkage does not establish final acceptance or model outcomes. Recorded reproduction commands are caller declarations, never executed or endorsed as API-free by the packager.

population_note: Planned populations are not completed observations. Final result roles remain pending until explicitly supplied.
scope: Lossless raw evidence and frozen source preservation; not a clone of the complete execution environment. Original files are never deleted or overwritten.

population.actual_counts_policy: No outcome aggregation is performed by the packager. Consult each retained generation plan, trace, cost ledger and certified evaluation separately; repeated copies and failed generations must not be pooled.

excluded.reason: Local original retained; excluded from Git evidence bundle; not a complete executable environment clone
rebuild_commands: Build the corresponding preserved Cargo.toml with the recorded Rust toolchain; see build_recipes.
